header.running_head: The Chapter Concerning The Unseen Assistance that the Sahabah (RA) Received

blocks.text: The Chapter Concerning The Unseen Assistance that the Sahabah (RA) Received

This chapter discusses how Nabi ﷺ and the Sahabah (RA) received unseen assistance when they left the material means, held firmly on to spiritual means and when the Sahabah (RA) shared the concern that Rasulullaah ﷺ had for the guidance of people and calling them towards Islaam. It also highlights how the Sahabah (RA) imbued within themselves the same character traits and noble qualities of Rasulullaah ﷺ.
Angels Assist the Sahabah (RA) during the Battle of Badr

Hadhrat Sahl bin Sa'd (RA) reports that after he had lost his eyesight, Hadhrat Abu Usayd (RA) said, "O son of my brother! By Allaah! If you and I were at Badr and Allaah restored my eyesight, I would show you the valley from where the angels came to (assist) us. Rest assured that I have absolutely no doubts or uncertainties about this." [^1]
Hadhrat Urwa (RA) says, "Hadhrat Jibra'eel (AS) descended during the Battle of Badr in the form of Zubayr (RA) and wearing a yellow turban with a part of it hanging over his face." [^2]

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abbaad bin Abdullaah bin Zubayr
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abbaad bin Abdullaah bin Zubayr reports that because Hadhrat Zubayr (RA) was wearing a yellow turban with a part of it hanging over his face, the angels also descended with yellow turbans on their heads." [^3]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) says, "The striking feature of (many of) the angels during the Battle of Badr was their white turbans (while others wore yellow turbans), the ends of which they let hang behind their backs.
